analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (Goal: Win Championship) is significantly overpaying in this proposed trade. Surrendering DeVonta Smith (89.1 C-AVI), David Montgomery (75.7 C-AVI), and a projected early 2028 1st draft pick for Quinshon Judkins (76.9 C-AVI / 90.1 D-AVI) and Denzel Boston (56.0 C-AVI / 82.0 D-AVI) severely damages Corgi's immediate starting lineup quality in a 16-team league. Surrendering DeVonta Smith creates a 21.5 C-AVI drop in starting lineup strength that cannot be offset by the minor RB upgrade from Montgomery to Judkins. While Rapid Valley Annihilation (Retooling) would accept this return, Corgi should DECLINE this proposal and pivot to a package that preserves DeVonta Smith.

Giving up an S-tier starting WR (DeVonta Smith), a productive starting RB (David Montgomery), and a projected high-end 2028 1st pick for a minor RB upgrade and a prospect WR severely degrades Corgi's championship starting lineup quality.

visualImpact.explanation: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. suffers a severe hit to its current championship window by surrendering its WR2 (DeVonta Smith) and an early 2028 1st pick, while Rapid Valley Annihilation secures an elite return that accelerates its retool.

officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: Corgi's starting lineup drops by 21.5 C-AVI index points. Losing DeVonta Smith forces Chuba Hubbard (66.4 C-AVI) or Denzel Boston (56.0 C-AVI) into the starting FLEX, creating a significant weak spot for a title contender.
officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: While Corgi acquires two 22-year-old assets (Judkins D-AVI 90.1, Boston D-AVI 82.0), surrendering an early projected 2028 1st (79.3 D-AVI) plus DeVonta Smith (92.8 D-AVI) results in a net long-term dynasty value loss.
officialAviAnalysis.sideARosterImpact: Creates an immediate starting WR hole while accumulating secondary depth at WR.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBChampionshipImpact: Rapid Valley immediately upgrades its starting lineup with DeVonta Smith (89.1 C-AVI) and David Montgomery (75.7 C-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideBDynastyImpact: Gains a prime 2028 1st draft pick (projected 1.01-1.05) and a 27-year-old high-end WR1/WR2 asset in DeVonta Smith.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBRosterImpact: Significantly strengthens starting WR and RB spots while adding prime draft capital.
officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: Side A sends ~257.9 total combined asset value for ~132.9 active C-AVI / ~172.1 D-AVI return. Value is heavily skewed toward Rapid Valley Annihilation.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public market consensus views DeVonta Smith as a top-18 dynasty WR and David Montgomery as a steady starting RB. Quinshon Judkins is a rising rookie RB2, while Denzel Boston is a breakout rookie receiver.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: AVI and public market both recognize DeVonta Smith as the premier asset in this deal. Public market strongly values early 1st round draft picks in dynasty formats.
relevantContext: DeVonta Smith is currently dealing with a hamstring issue, but remains a long-term elite dynasty WR.
Quinshon Judkins is securing heavy volume in Cleveland, elevating his dynasty trajectory.
Denzel Boston has broken out early with 284 receiving yards and 2 TDs through 4 weeks.
David Montgomery's efficiency in Houston has slowed after Week 1, making him touchdown-dependent.

frontOfficeAnalysis.opposingGmMotivation: Rapid Valley Annihilation is currently in Retool mode. They would be thrilled to receive an elite WR, starting RB, and an early 2028 1st for two young assets.
frontOfficeAnalysis.packageFit: The package offers Rapid Valley overwhelming value and future capital.
frontOfficeAnalysis.lineupReplacement: Rapid Valley seamlessly replaces Judkins with Montgomery at RB while adding DeVonta Smith to WR.
frontOfficeAnalysis.competitiveWindowFit: Rapid Valley gets future capital (2028 1st) and proven high-end talent.
frontOfficeAnalysis.positionalScarcity: Starting WRs of DeVonta Smith's caliber are extremely scarce and vital in 16-team PPR leagues.

marketReality.explanation: Rapid Valley Annihilation would accept this submitted proposal almost instantly because it heavily favors them across every valuation metric.

verdict.rationale: As Corgi Loaf Baking Co., your objective is to Win Championship. Surrendering DeVonta Smith degrades your starting lineup C-AVI significantly, and paying David Montgomery PLUS a projected top-5 2028 1st pick on top of DeVonta Smith is an extreme overpay. Do not send this trade.

recommendedOffer.whyUserShouldDoIt: You keep DeVonta Smith locked in as your starting WR2 while upgrading David Montgomery to 22-year-old Quinshon Judkins at RB2 and adding high-upside young WR depth in Denzel Boston.
recommendedOffer.whyOpponentMightAccept: Rapid Valley (Retooling) gets a starting RB replacement in Montgomery plus a prime projected top-5 2028 1st round pick to fuel their retooling process.

alternateOffer.rationale: A player-for-player shift at RB where Corgi gains 7 years of youth with Judkins while Rapid Valley gains a veteran starting RB for immediate production.
